scope: Desktop product hardening, with particular attention to The Olds and vertical story topography.
fixes: The Olds measures its timeline only when content, scroll position or size changes, rather than continuously re-rendering while idle.
Terrain cache keys include summit coordinates, footprints and coverage abroad, so geographic updates cannot be silently ignored.
Hover picking reads current story metadata while unchanged geometry is reused.
Story picking wraps correctly across the longitude seam.
Terrain transitions settle immediately under reduced motion, including a transition already in progress.
Valid country-wide footprints larger than 2,000 km survive digest validation, preserving every story and the peak ranking.
Opening Commands explicitly resets dismissed address suggestions and any previous selection.
